title: O‘qish strategiyasi: tez ko‘z yugurtirish va qidirish
goal_uz: Dars oxirida matnni bir daqiqada skimming qilib asosiy g‘oyasini aytasiz, scanning bilan uch daqiqada kamida yettita faktni topasiz, sarlavhalarni moslashtirasiz va imtihon vaqtini rejalaysiz.

scenes.title: Tez o‘qish: skimming va scanning
board: Skimming + scanning (tez ko‘z yugurtirish va qidirish)
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda tinglab tushunishda asosiy g‘oya bilan tafsilotni ajratishni o‘rgandik. Bugun xuddi shu ikki qatlamni o‘qishda ishlatamiz. Dars oxirida siz matnni bir daqiqada ko‘zdan kechirib, asosiy g‘oyasini ayta olasiz, kerakli ma’lumotni esa soniyalarda topasiz, imtihon vaqtini esa to‘g‘ri taqsimlay olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back! Last time you separated the main idea from the details in listening. Today you will do the same with reading, but much faster.
scenes.say_uz: Qaytganingiz bilan! O‘tgan safar tinglashda asosiy g‘oyani tafsilotlardan ajratdingiz. Bugun xuddi shuni o‘qishda, lekin ancha tezroq qilasiz.

scenes.title: Nega hamma so‘zni o‘qimaymiz?
scenes.say_native: Odamlar ona tilida ham hamma matnni bir xil o‘qimaydi. Gazeta sarlavhasiga ko‘z yugurtirasiz, dori yo‘riqnomasini esa so‘zma-so‘z o‘qiysiz. B2 imtihonida esa matn uzun, vaqt kam. Shuning uchun avval o‘qish maqsadini aniqlaymiz: umumiy fikrni bilmoqchimizmi yoki aniq ma’lumotnimi?
scenes.say: We never read everything in the same way. A newspaper headline, a medicine leaflet and an exam text each need a different speed. First decide your purpose, then choose your method.
scenes.say_uz: Biz hech qachon hamma narsani bir xil o‘qimaymiz. Gazeta sarlavhasi, dori yo‘riqnomasi va imtihon matni turli tezlikni talab qiladi. Avval maqsadni aniqlang, keyin usulni tanlang.

scenes.title: Skimming nima?

examples.t: What is this text mainly about?

scenes.say_native: Skimming bu matnga tezda ko‘z yugurtirib, umumiy mazmunni, ya’ni gist ni tushunishdir. “Skim” so‘zi aslida suyuqlikning yuzasini sidirib olish degani, ya’ni biz matnning chuqurligiga emas, yuzasiga qaraymiz. Maqsad bitta: matn nima haqida va muallif nima demoqchi. Tafsilotlar hozircha kerak emas.
scenes.say: Skimming means reading quickly to understand the gist, the general idea of a text. You do not need the details yet. One minute is usually enough.
scenes.say_uz: Skimming matnni tez o‘qib, uning umumiy mazmunini, ya’ni gistni tushunishdir. Tafsilotlar hozircha kerak emas. Odatda bir daqiqa yetadi.

scenes.title: Skimming qadamlari
scenes.say_native: Skimming ni to‘rt qadamga bo‘lamiz. Birinchi: sarlavha va ichki sarlavhalarni o‘qing. Ikkinchi: birinchi va oxirgi xatboshini o‘qing, chunki muallif mavzuni boshida, xulosani oxirida beradi. Uchinchi: har xatboshining birinchi gapini o‘qing. To‘rtinchi: qalin harflar, raqamlar va rasmlarga qarang.
scenes.say: Read the title and subheadings. Read the first and last paragraphs. Then read the first sentence of every paragraph. Finally, notice bold words, numbers and pictures.
scenes.say_uz: Sarlavha va ichki sarlavhalarni o‘qing. Birinchi va oxirgi xatboshini o‘qing. Keyin har xatboshining birinchi gapini o‘qing. Oxirida qalin so‘zlar, raqamlar va rasmlarga e’tibor bering.

scenes.title: Birinchi matn: shaharlar va shovqin
board: Skim: what is the main idea?
scenes.say_native: Endi mashq uchun qisqa matn. Uni tinglab, faqat umumiy fikrni ushlashga harakat qiling. Har bir so‘zni tarjima qilmang, ayniqsa gapdagi bog‘lovchi so‘zlarga, masalan “however” va “overall” ga quloq soling. Ular muallifning fikr yo‘nalishini ko‘rsatadi.
scenes.say: Many cities are trying to become quieter. Some now use cameras that measure the noise of passing vehicles. Others are replacing diesel buses with electric ones. Doctors say constant noise raises stress and harms sleep. However, some residents say the new rules are expensive and hard to enforce. Overall, the evidence suggests that quieter streets benefit most people.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘p shaharlar tinchroq bo‘lishga harakat qilmoqda. Ba’zilari endi o‘tayotgan transportning shovqinini o‘lchaydigan kameralardan foydalanadi. Boshqalari dizel avtobuslarni elektrlilariga almashtirmoqda. Shifokorlarning aytishicha, doimiy shovqin stressni oshiradi va uyquga zarar qiladi. Biroq ba’zi aholi yangi qoidalar qimmat va nazorat qilish qiyin deydi. Umuman, dalillar tinchroq ko‘chalar ko‘pchilikka foyda berishini ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.title: Asosiy g‘oyani toping
board: B) Cities reduce noise, and it seems worthwhile
C) Electric buses are too expensive
scenes.say_native: Matnning asosiy g‘oyasi qaysi? A, B yoki C. Javob berishdan oldin o‘ylab ko‘ring: qaysi variant butun matnni qamrab oladi, qaysi biri esa faqat bitta tafsilotni aytadi? Elektr avtobuslar tilga olindi, lekin matn faqat ular haqida emas. Javobingizni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: What is the main idea of the text? A, B or C? Choose the answer that covers the whole text, not just one detail.
scenes.say_uz: Matnning asosiy g‘oyasi nima? A, B yoki C? Butun matnni qamrab oladigan javobni tanlang, faqat bitta tafsilotni emas.

scenes.title: Javob: B
board: B) Cities reduce noise, and it seems worthwhile
A = false, C = only one detail
scenes.say_native: To‘g‘ri javob B. Shaharlar shovqinni kamaytirmoqda va oxirgi gap “overall” bilan buning foydali ekanini aytadi. A noto‘g‘ri, chunki qoidalar noqonuniy deyilmagan. C esa tuzoq: narx masalasi faqat bitta e’tiroz, matnning markazi emas. Yaxshi gist javobi har doim butun matnga mos keladi, bitta tafsilotga emas.
scenes.say: The answer is B. The text describes how cities reduce noise, and the last sentence says the evidence is positive. Option C mentions only one small detail.
scenes.say_uz: Javob B. Matn shaharlar shovqinni qanday kamaytirayotganini tasvirlaydi, oxirgi gap esa dalillar ijobiy ekanini aytadi. C faqat bitta kichik tafsilotni tilga oladi.

scenes.title: Bog‘lovchi so‘zlar yo‘l ko‘rsatadi
scenes.say_native: Skimming paytida signal so‘zlarga qarang. “However” va “but” dan keyin fikr ko‘pincha o‘zgaradi. “For example” dan keyin tafsilot keladi, uni o‘tkazib yuborsa bo‘ladi. “Overall”, “in conclusion” va “therefore” esa muallifning asosiy xulosasini olib keladi.
scenes.say: Signal words guide your eyes. However and but show contrast. For example introduces a detail you can skip. Overall and in conclusion lead to the main message.
scenes.say_uz: Signal so‘zlar ko‘zingizni yo‘naltiradi. However va but qarama-qarshilikni ko‘rsatadi. For example tafsilot keltiradi, uni o‘tkazish mumkin. Overall va in conclusion asosiy xulosaga olib boradi.

scenes.title: Skimming dagi uchta xato
board: ✓ Keep your eyes moving; gist first
scenes.say_native: Eng katta xato: skimming paytida har bir so‘zni o‘qish yoki bilmagan so‘zda to‘xtab, lug‘at izlash. Bu bilan siz bir daqiqani yo‘qotasiz, umumiy rasm esa chiqmaydi. Uchinchi xato: ichingizda o‘zbekchaga tarjima qilib borish. Tarjima tezlikni ikki baravar sekinlashtiradi.
scenes.say: Do not read every word. Do not stop at every unknown word. Do not translate in your head. Keep your eyes moving and look for the gist first.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir so‘zni o‘qimang. Har bir noma’lum so‘zda to‘xtamang. Ichingizda tarjima qilmang. Ko‘zingizni harakatda ushlang va avval gistni qidiring.

scenes.title: Scanning nima?
board: Eyes move fast; you read only the answer area
scenes.say_native: Scanning bu aniq ma’lumotni qidirishdir: ism, raqam, sana, narx, joy nomi. Skimming matnni umumiy ko‘rsa, scanning kerakli nuqtani topadi va faqat o‘sha joyni o‘qiydi. O‘xshatish: telefon ro‘yxatidan raqamni qidirishda hamma ismni o‘qimaysiz, faqat kerakli ismga qarab ko‘zingiz yuguradi. Matnda ham shunday.
scenes.say: Scanning means looking for one specific piece of information, such as a name, a number, a date or a price. You do not read everything. You move your eyes until you find it, then you read that area carefully.
scenes.say_uz: Scanning aniq ma’lumotni qidirishdir: ism, raqam, sana yoki narx. Siz hamma narsani o‘qimaysiz. Topguncha ko‘z yugurtirasiz, keyin o‘sha joyni diqqat bilan o‘qiysiz.

scenes.title: Scanning usuli: besh qadam
board: 2 Predict the form: number? name? date?
4 Stop at a match, read around it
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: savolni o‘qib, kalit so‘zlarni belgilang. Ikkinchi: javob qanday ko‘rinishda bo‘lishini taxmin qiling: raqammi, bosh harf bilan yozilgan ismmi, sanami. Uchinchi: matn bo‘ylab ko‘z yugurtiring, o‘qimang. To‘rtinchi: mos joyda to‘xtab, atrofini o‘qing. Beshinchi: javob savolga mosligini tekshiring.
scenes.say: Underline the keywords in the question. Predict what the answer looks like. Sweep the text with your eyes. Stop when you find a match and read around it. Finally, check that the answer fits the question.
scenes.say_uz: Savoldagi kalit so‘zlarni belgilang. Javob qanday ko‘rinishini taxmin qiling. Matn bo‘ylab ko‘z yugurtiring. Mos joyni topsangiz, to‘xtab atrofini o‘qing. Oxirida javob savolga mosligini tekshiring.

scenes.title: Savol va matnda so‘zlar har xil
board: Question: How much does a child ticket cost?
scenes.say_native: Imtihonda savoldagi so‘z matnda aynan takrorlanmaydi. Savolda “child ticket”, matnda esa “under-16s pay”. Shuning uchun faqat so‘zning o‘zini emas, uning sinonimini va ma’no jihatidan yaqin variantini ham qidiring. Raqamlar, sanalar va bosh harf bilan yozilgan so‘zlar esa o‘zgarmaydi, ular eng ishonchli tayanch nuqta.
scenes.say: In exams the words in the question are often different from the words in the text. Child ticket in the question may become under-16s pay in the text. Numbers, dates and names stay the same, so use them as anchors.
scenes.say_uz: Imtihonda savoldagi so‘zlar matnda boshqacha bo‘ladi. Savoldagi child ticket matnda under-16s pay bo‘lishi mumkin. Raqam, sana va ismlar o‘zgarmaydi, ularni tayanch qilib oling.

scenes.title: Scanning dagi xatolar
board: ✗ Reading the whole text for one fact
✗ Searching only for the exact question word
scenes.say_native: Birinchi xato: bitta ma’lumot uchun butun matnni boshidan o‘qish, bu ko‘p daqiqani yeydi. Ikkinchi xato: faqat savoldagi so‘zning aynan o‘zini qidirish, ya’ni sinonimni payqamaslik. To‘g‘ri yo‘l: javob shaklini taxmin qiling, ko‘z yugurtiring, mos joyda to‘xtang va atrofini o‘qing.
scenes.say: Do not read the whole text for one fact. Do not search only for the exact word from the question. Predict the answer, sweep, stop and read around it.
scenes.say_uz: Bitta fakt uchun butun matnni o‘qimang. Faqat savoldagi so‘zning o‘zini qidirmang. Javobni taxmin qiling, ko‘z yugurtiring, to‘xtang va atrofini o‘qing.

scenes.title: Ikkinchi matn: ilm-fan markazi
scenes.say_native: Mana haqiqiy varaq namunasi. Siz uni tinglaysiz, lekin mashq paytida ko‘zingiz doskadagi qisqa yozuvda ham yuradi, xuddi haqiqiy scanning kabi. Kalit ma’lumotlarni ushlashga harakat qiling: kunlar, narxlar, vaqtlar. Keyingi sahnada savollar beriladi.
scenes.say: Harbour Science Centre. Open Tuesday to Sunday, ten a.m. to five p.m. Closed on Mondays. Adult tickets cost twelve pounds fifty, children under sixteen pay seven pounds, and under-fives enter free. The planetarium show starts at eleven thirty and two fifteen. Guided tours leave from the main hall. Parking is behind the building, three pounds a day.
scenes.say_uz: Harbor ilm-fan markazi. Seshanbadan yakshanbagacha, ertalab o‘ndan kechki beshgacha ochiq. Dushanba kunlari yopiq. Kattalar chiptasi o‘n ikki funt ellik pens, o‘n olti yoshgacha bolalar yetti funt to‘laydi, besh yoshgacha bepul. Planetariy namoyishi o‘n bir o‘ttizda va ikki o‘n beshda boshlanadi. Ekskursiyalar asosiy zaldan chiqadi. Avtoturargoh bino orqasida, kuniga uch funt.

scenes.title: Tez toping
scenes.say_native: Endi scanning. To‘rtta savol bor: qaysi kuni yopiq, o‘n yoshli bola uchun chipta narxi, planetariyning ikkinchi namoyishi qachon, ekskursiya qayerdan chiqadi. Har bir savolda javob qanday ko‘rinishda bo‘lishini oldindan taxmin qiling: kun, narx, vaqt, joy. Doskaga qarab, tez javob bering.
scenes.say: Four quick questions. Which day is the centre closed? How much is a ticket for a ten-year-old? When is the second planetarium show? Where do the tours leave from?
scenes.say_uz: To‘rtta tez savol. Markaz qaysi kuni yopiq? O‘n yoshli bola uchun chipta qancha? Planetariyning ikkinchi namoyishi qachon? Ekskursiyalar qayerdan chiqadi?

scenes.title: Scanning javoblari
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: dushanba; yetti funt, chunki o‘n yosh o‘n oltidan kichik, ya’ni “child” bu yerda “under sixteen” bo‘lib keldi; ikkinchi namoyish kunduzi ikki o‘n besh; ekskursiya asosiy zaldan, “main hall”. Ko‘rdingizmi, ikkinchi savolda sinonim kerak bo‘ldi. Agar o‘zingiz qiynalgan bo‘lsangiz, keyingi mashqda kalit so‘zlarni oldindan belgilang.
scenes.say: Monday. Seven pounds, because a ten-year-old is under sixteen. Two fifteen p.m. The main hall. Question two needed a paraphrase: child became under sixteen.
scenes.say_uz: Dushanba. Yetti funt, chunki o‘n yoshli bola o‘n olti yoshdan kichik. Kunduzi ikki o‘n besh. Asosiy zal. Ikkinchi savolda child so‘zi under sixteen bo‘lib keldi.

scenes.title: True, False yoki Not Given
board: Not Given = text says nothing about it
scenes.say_native: Imtihonda ko‘pincha uch javobli savol uchraydi. “True” matn aynan shu fikrni aytganda; “False” matn teskarisini aytganda; “Not Given” matnda bu haqida umuman gap bo‘lmaganda. Eng katta tuzoq: o‘z hayotiy bilimingizga tayanib “False” deyish. Faqat matnga tayaning.
scenes.say: True means the text agrees. False means the text says the opposite. Not Given means the text does not mention it at all. Use only the text, never your own knowledge.
scenes.say_uz: True: matn rozi. False: matn teskarisini aytadi. Not Given: matnda bu haqida gap yo‘q. Faqat matnga tayaning, o‘z bilimingizga emas.

scenes.title: True, False, Not Given
board: 1 The centre is open on Sundays.
3 There is a cafe on site.
scenes.say_native: Harbor markazi matniga qayting. Uchta gap: markaz yakshanba kuni ochiq; avtoturargoh bepul; hududda kafe bor. Har birini “True”, “False” yoki “Not Given” deb belgilang. Esda tuting, faqat matnda aytilganiga tayaning. Kerak bo‘lsa, doskadagi qisqa yozuvga qarang.
scenes.say: Look back at the Harbour Science Centre text. The centre is open on Sundays. Parking is free. There is a cafe on site. True, false or not given?
scenes.say_uz: Harbor markazi matniga qayting. Markaz yakshanba kuni ochiq. Avtoturargoh bepul. Hududda kafe bor. To‘g‘ri, noto‘g‘ri yoki aytilmagan?

scenes.title: T/F/NG javoblari
scenes.say_native: Birinchisi “True”: seshanbadan yakshanbagacha ochiq. Ikkinchisi “False”: kuniga uch funt, demak bepul emas. Uchinchisi “Not Given”: kafe haqida bir og‘iz ham gap yo‘q. Ko‘p o‘quvchilar bunga “False” deydi, chunki kafe yo‘q deb o‘ylaydi. Lekin matn “kafe yo‘q” demagan, shunchaki aytmagan. Farq mana shunda.
scenes.say: One is true: it is open Tuesday to Sunday. Two is false: parking costs three pounds a day. Three is not given: the text never mentions a cafe.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchisi to‘g‘ri: seshanbadan yakshanbagacha ochiq. Ikkinchisi noto‘g‘ri: avtoturargoh kuniga uch funt. Uchinchisi aytilmagan: matnda kafe tilga olinmagan.

scenes.title: Vaqtni boshqarish
board: Total 60 min, 3 texts -> about 18 min each
Skim 1-2 min, answer questions, then move on
scenes.say_native: Endi vaqt. Aytaylik, imtihonda bir soat va uchta matn bor. Har matnga taxminan o‘n sakkiz daqiqa ajrating, oxirida besh-olti daqiqa tekshirishga qoldiring. Har matnni bir-ikki daqiqa skimming bilan boshlang, keyin savollarni ishlang. Qiyin savolga yopishib olmang: belgi qo‘yib, keyingisiga o‘ting, oxirida qaytasiz.
scenes.say: Imagine one hour and three texts. Give each text about eighteen minutes and keep five or six minutes to check. Start with a one or two minute skim. If a question is too hard, mark it and move on.
scenes.say_uz: Tasavvur qiling, bir soat va uchta matn bor. Har matnga o‘n sakkiz daqiqa bering, tekshirishga besh-olti daqiqa qoldiring. Bir-ikki daqiqalik skimming bilan boshlang. Savol juda qiyin bo‘lsa, belgilab o‘ting.

scenes.title: Vaqtni yo‘qotadigan odatlar
board: ✓ Mark it, move on, return later; guess if no penalty
scenes.say_native: Uch xato. Birinchi: bitta savolga o‘n daqiqa sarflab, oxirgi matnga ulgurmaslik. Ikkinchi: bo‘sh javob qoldirish; ko‘p imtihonlarda noto‘g‘ri javobga jarima yo‘q, shuning uchun taxmin qilgan ma’qul, lekin avval imtihon qoidalarini bilib oling. Uchinchi: oxirgi matnni eng qiyin deb o‘ylab, ishni undan boshlash.
scenes.say: Do not spend ten minutes on one question. Do not leave blanks if there is no penalty for wrong answers. Mark hard questions, move on and come back later.
scenes.say_uz: Bitta savolga o‘n daqiqa sarflamang. Noto‘g‘ri javobga jarima bo‘lmasa, bo‘sh qoldirmang. Qiyin savollarni belgilab, o‘tib keting va keyin qayting.

scenes.title: Vaqt rejasi
board: How long to check at the end?
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Sizda bir soat va uchta matn bor. Bitta matnga qancha vaqt bergan bo‘lardingiz va oxirida tekshirishga necha daqiqa qoldirasiz? Hisoblab, baland ovozda ayting. Misol uchun, agar tekshirishga olti daqiqa qoldirsangiz, qolgan vaqtni uchga bo‘ling.
scenes.say: You have sixty minutes and three texts. How long will you spend on each text, and how many minutes will you keep for checking at the end?
scenes.say_uz: Sizda oltmish daqiqa va uchta matn bor. Har matnga qancha vaqt sarflaysiz va oxirida tekshirishga necha daqiqa qoldirasiz?

scenes.title: Reja javobi
scenes.say_native: Misol reja: tekshirishga olti daqiqa, qolgan ellik to‘rt daqiqani uchga bo‘lsak, har matnga o‘n sakkiz daqiqa. Bu o‘n sakkizdan ikki daqiqa skimming ga, o‘n to‘rt daqiqa savollarga, ikki daqiqa zaxiraga. Soatingizni stol ustiga qo‘ying va har matn oxirida qarang.
scenes.say: A sample plan: six minutes to check, so fifty-four minutes divided by three is eighteen per text. That means two minutes to skim, fourteen for questions and two spare.
scenes.say_uz: Namuna reja: tekshirishga olti daqiqa, qolgan ellik to‘rt daqiqani uchga bo‘lsak, matn boshiga o‘n sakkiz daqiqa. Ikki daqiqa skimming, o‘n to‘rt daqiqa savollar, ikki daqiqa zaxira.

scenes.title: Sarlavhalarni moslashtirish
board: Matching headings = main idea of each paragraph
Read the first/last sentence of each paragraph
scenes.say_native: Matching headings topshirig‘ida har xatboshiga mos sarlavha tanlanadi. Bu sof skimming. Har xatboshining birinchi va oxirgi gapini o‘qing, mavzu gapini belgilang va o‘zingizdan so‘rang: butun xatboshi nima haqida? Sarlavhalar xatboshidagi so‘zlarni aynan takrorlamaydi, ular qayta ifodalangan bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: In a matching headings task, you choose the best heading for each paragraph. Read the first and last sentences, find the topic sentence and ask what the whole paragraph is about. The headings use different words from the text.
scenes.say_uz: Matching headings topshirig‘ida har xatboshi uchun eng mos sarlavhani tanlaysiz. Birinchi va oxirgi gapni o‘qing, mavzu gapini toping va xatboshi nima haqida ekanini so‘rang. Sarlavhalar matndan boshqa so‘zlar bilan yozilgan.

scenes.title: Sarlavha tuzoqlari
board: ✗ Heading too narrow or too broad
✓ Match the MAIN idea; each heading once only
scenes.say_native: Eng keng tarqalgan xato: xatboshidagi so‘z sarlavhada ham bor ekan, uni tanlash. Ko‘pincha aynan o‘sha sarlavha tuzoq bo‘ladi. Yana ikki tuzoq: sarlavha juda tor, ya’ni faqat bitta tafsilotni qamraydi, yoki juda keng. Va esda tuting, har sarlavha faqat bir marta ishlatiladi, shuning uchun eliminatsiya, ya’ni noto‘g‘rilarini chiqarib tashlash ham yordam beradi.
scenes.say: Do not choose a heading just because it repeats a word from the paragraph. Beware of headings that are too narrow or too broad. Each heading can be used only once.
scenes.say_uz: Faqat xatboshidagi so‘z takrorlangani uchun sarlavhani tanlamang. Juda tor yoki juda keng sarlavhalardan ehtiyot bo‘ling. Har sarlavha faqat bir marta ishlatiladi.

scenes.title: Uchinchi matn: uyqu
board: D Why we dream | E Medicine for insomnia
scenes.say_native: Endi uch qisqa xatboshini tinglang, doskada esa beshta sarlavha bor. Uch xatboshi uchun uchta sarlavhani topishingiz kerak, ikkitasi ortiqcha. Eslab qoling, sarlavhalar xatboshidagi so‘zlarni aynan takrorlamaydi, ma’noga qarang. Har xatboshining asosiy fikrini ushlashga harakat qiling.
scenes.say: Paragraph one. Experts once insisted on eight unbroken hours of sleep. New research suggests there is no single perfect pattern. Paragraph two. Bright phone screens trick the brain into thinking it is daytime, so experts advise switching them off an hour before bed. Paragraph three. Coffee in the late afternoon can still affect us at midnight, and a heavy meal near bedtime makes relaxing harder.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi xatboshi. Mutaxassislar bir paytlar sakkiz soatlik uzluksiz uyquni talab qilardi. Yangi tadqiqotlar yagona mukammal tartib yo‘qligini ko‘rsatmoqda. Ikkinchi xatboshi. Telefon ekranlarining yorqin nuri miyani kun deb o‘ylashga aldaydi, shuning uchun mutaxassislar ularni yotishdan bir soat oldin o‘chirishni maslahat beradi. Uchinchi xatboshi. Kechki payt ichilgan kofe yarim kechada ham ta’sir qilishi mumkin, tungi og‘ir taom esa dam olishni qiyinlashtiradi.

scenes.title: Sarlavhalarni moslang
scenes.say_native: Har xatboshi uchun A dan E gacha bitta sarlavhani tanlang. Birinchisida asosiy fikr nima haqida: uyqu tartibi. Ikkinchisida: telefon va yorug‘lik. Uchinchisida: kofe va ovqat. D va E haqida matnda hech narsa aytilmagan. Javoblarni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Choose one heading from A to E for each paragraph. Remember that two headings are extra.
scenes.say_uz: Har xatboshi uchun A dan E gacha bittadan sarlavha tanlang. Ikkita sarlavha ortiqcha ekanini unutmang.

scenes.title: Sarlavha javoblari
scenes.say_native: Birinchi xatboshi A: sakkiz soatlik uyqu haqidagi eski qarash o‘zgaryapti, ya’ni “ideal night” qayta o‘ylanmoqda. Ikkinchisi B: ekranlar, ya’ni “devices”. Uchinchisi C: kofe va og‘ir ovqat, ya’ni “what we consume”. D va E matnda umuman yo‘q. Ko‘rdingizmi, hech bir sarlavha matndagi so‘zni aynan takrorlamadi, ma’no mos keldi.
scenes.say: One is A, because the old idea of the ideal night is changing. Two is B, because phone screens are devices. Three is C, because coffee and food are what we consume. D and E are not in the text.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchisi A: ideal tun haqidagi eski fikr o‘zgaryapti. Ikkinchisi B: telefon ekranlari qurilmalardir. Uchinchisi C: kofe va ovqat biz iste’mol qiladigan narsa. D va E matnda yo‘q.

scenes.title: Dialog: imtihonga tayyorgarlik
board: Maya: I run out of time in the reading paper.
Ben: Skim first, then read the questions.
scenes.say_native: Endi birinchi tinglash dialogi. Ikki talaba, Maya va Ben, o‘qish imtihoniga tayyorlanyapti. Maya vaqt yetishmasligidan shikoyat qiladi, Ben esa maslahat beradi. Tinglang va ikki narsani ushlang: Mayaning muammosi nima va Ben qanday yo‘l taklif qiladi. Tezlik oddiy suhbatdagidek, bir marta eshitasiz.
scenes.say: Maya: I always run out of time in the reading paper. I read every word of the first text, and then I only have twenty minutes for the other two. Ben: That is the problem. Skim for a minute, then read the questions and scan for keywords. Maya: What if I do not know a word? Ben: Ignore it, unless it is in a question. Then guess from the context.
scenes.say_uz: Maya: Men o‘qish imtihonida doim vaqtim yetmaydi. Birinchi matnning har so‘zini o‘qiyman, boshqa ikkitasiga atigi yigirma daqiqa qoladi. Ben: Muammo shunda. Bir daqiqa skimming qil, keyin savollarni o‘qib, kalit so‘zlarni qidir. Maya: Bilmagan so‘z bo‘lsa-chi? Ben: Savolda bo‘lmasa, e’tibor berma. Savolda bo‘lsa, kontekstdan taxmin qil.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
board: 3 When should she guess a word?
scenes.say_native: Dialogdan uchta savol. Birinchi: Mayaning muammosi nima? Ikkinchi: Ben unga qancha vaqt skimming qilishni maslahat beradi? Uchinchi: qachon bilmagan so‘zni kontekstdan taxmin qilish kerak? Eslashga harakat qiling va gaplar bilan to‘liq javob bering.
scenes.say: Three questions about the dialogue. What is Maya's problem? How long should she skim? When should she guess a word from the context?
scenes.say_uz: Dialog bo‘yicha uchta savol. Mayaning muammosi nima? U qancha vaqt skimming qilishi kerak? Qachon so‘zni kontekstdan taxmin qilish kerak?

scenes.title: Dialog javoblari
board: 1 She reads every word and runs out of time
3 When the word is in a question
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: Maya har so‘zni o‘qiydi va keyingi matnlarga vaqt qolmaydi. Ikkinchi: taxminan bir daqiqa. Uchinchi: faqat bilmagan so‘z savolda bo‘lsa, kontekstdan taxmin qilinadi, aks holda e’tibor berilmaydi. E’tibor bering, Benning maslahati bugungi darsimizning qisqa mazmuni: avval skimming, keyin savollar, keyin scanning.
scenes.say: Maya reads every word and runs out of time. Ben says about one minute. She should guess only when the word is in a question. His advice is the lesson in short: skim, read the questions, then scan.
scenes.say_uz: Maya har so‘zni o‘qiydi va vaqti tugaydi. Ben taxminan bir daqiqa deydi. Taxmin faqat so‘z savolda bo‘lsa kerak. Uning maslahati darsning qisqacha mazmuni: skimming, savollar, keyin scanning.

scenes.title: Dialog: o‘qituvchi bilan suhbat
board: Omar: I did badly on matching headings.
Teacher: Cross out wrong headings; each is used once.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. O‘quvchi Omar o‘qituvchisi Mrs Hall bilan sarlavhalarni moslashtirish topshirig‘ini muhokama qilmoqda. Tinglang: Omar qaysi xatoni qilgan, o‘qituvchi esa qanday strategiyani maslahat beradi? Bu dialogda siz bugun o‘rgangan tuzoqning aniq namunasini eshitasiz.
scenes.say: Omar: I scored well on the gist questions, but badly on matching headings. Teacher: Which heading went wrong? Omar: Number three. I chose the one with the same word as the paragraph. Teacher: That is a common trap. Ask what the whole paragraph is about. Omar: And if two headings look possible? Teacher: Cross out the wrong ones. Each heading can be used only once.
scenes.say_uz: Omar: Gist savollarida yaxshi ball oldim, lekin sarlavhalarni moslashtirishda yomon. O‘qituvchi: Qaysi sarlavha xato bo‘ldi? Omar: Uchinchisi. Xatboshidagi so‘z bilan bir xil so‘zli sarlavhani tanladim. O‘qituvchi: Bu keng tarqalgan tuzoq. Butun xatboshi nima haqida ekanini so‘rang. Omar: Ikki sarlavha mos ko‘rinsa-chi? O‘qituvchi: Noto‘g‘rilarini chizib tashlang. Har sarlavha faqat bir marta ishlatiladi.

scenes.title: Ikkinchi dialog savollari
board: 1 Which task did Omar do badly?
2 Why did he choose the wrong heading?
3 What helps when two headings look possible?
scenes.say_native: Savollar. Birinchi: Omar qaysi topshiriqda yomon natija ko‘rsatdi? Ikkinchi: u nima uchun noto‘g‘ri sarlavhani tanladi? Uchinchi: ikki sarlavha mos ko‘rinsa, nima yordam beradi? Javoblaringiz qisqa va aniq bo‘lsin. Dialogdagi o‘qituvchining so‘zlarini eslang.
scenes.say: Which task did Omar do badly? Why did he choose the wrong heading? What helps when two headings look possible?
scenes.say_uz: Omar qaysi topshiriqda yomon natija oldi? U nega noto‘g‘ri sarlavhani tanladi? Ikki sarlavha mos ko‘rinsa, nima yordam beradi?

scenes.title: Ikkinchi dialog javoblari
board: 2 He chose the heading with the same word
3 Crossing out wrong ones; each heading once
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchi, sarlavhalarni moslashtirish. Ikkinchi, u xatboshidagi so‘z takrorlangan sarlavhani tanlagan, ya’ni tuzoqqa tushgan. Uchinchi, noto‘g‘ri variantlarni chizib tashlash, chunki har sarlavha faqat bir marta ishlatiladi. Bu eliminatsiya usuli nafaqat sarlavhalarda, balki ko‘p tanlovli savollarda ham ishlaydi.
scenes.say: Matching headings. He chose the heading that repeated a word from the paragraph. Crossing out the wrong headings helps, because each heading is used once. This elimination method works in multiple choice too.
scenes.say_uz: Sarlavhalarni moslashtirish. U xatboshidagi so‘zni takrorlagan sarlavhani tanladi. Noto‘g‘ri sarlavhalarni chizib tashlash yordam beradi, chunki har sarlavha bir marta ishlatiladi. Bu usul ko‘p tanlovli savollarda ham ishlaydi.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: darsning kalit so‘zlari
scenes.say_native: Bugungi atamalarning talaffuzi. “Skim” qisqa “i” bilan, “scan” esa “a” bilan, o‘zbekchadagi “e” ga yaqin keng tovush. “Gist” dagi birinchi tovush “dj” ga o‘xshaydi. “Paragraph” da urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda: PAragraph, oxiri Britaniyada cho‘ziq “aaf”, Amerikada qisqa “af”. “Heading” va “keyword” ham birinchi bo‘g‘inda urg‘uli. Takrorlang.
scenes.say: Skim, scan, gist. Paragraph, heading, keyword. The stress is on the first syllable in paragraph, heading and keyword.
scenes.say_uz: Skim, scan, gist. Paragraph, heading, keyword. Paragraph, heading va keyword da urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda.

scenes.title: Yakuniy matn: Lakeside tili maktabi
board: Scan for 4 facts: year, students, price, discount
scenes.say_native: Endi yakuniy mashq. Matn qisqa, lekin ma’lumotga boy. Siz to‘rtta faktni topishingiz kerak: maktab qaysi yili ochilgan, nechta o‘quvchisi bor, to‘rt haftalik kurs narxi nechchi va chegirma necha foiz. Avval savollarni eslab oling, keyin matnni tinglang, raqamlarni ushlashga harakat qiling.
scenes.say: Lakeside Language School was founded in nineteen ninety-eight by two teachers, Anna Reyes and Tom Hale. It now has four hundred and fifty students from thirty countries. Classes run Monday to Friday. A four-week course costs six hundred and forty pounds, and early booking earns a ten per cent discount. The library has three thousand books.
scenes.say_uz: Lakeside til maktabi 1998 yilda ikki o‘qituvchi, Anna Reyes va Tom Heyl tomonidan asos solingan. Hozir unda o‘ttiz mamlakatdan to‘rt yuz ellik o‘quvchi bor. Darslar dushanbadan jumagacha. To‘rt haftalik kurs olti yuz qirq funt, erta band qilinsa, o‘n foiz chegirma. Kutubxonada uch ming kitob bor.

scenes.title: To‘rtta fakt
scenes.say_native: Faktlarni ayting: maktab qaysi yili tashkil topgan, o‘quvchilar soni qancha, to‘rt haftalik kurs narxi, erta band qilish chegirmasi. Agar birortasini ushlamagan bo‘lsangiz, hech qisi yo‘q: haqiqiy imtihonda matn ko‘z oldingizda bo‘ladi va siz uni qayta ko‘ra olasiz. Hozir quloq bilan sinab ko‘ring.
scenes.say: Say the four facts. What year was the school founded? How many students does it have? How much is a four-week course? What discount does early booking give?
scenes.say_uz: To‘rtta faktni ayting. Maktab qaysi yili tashkil topgan? Nechta o‘quvchisi bor? To‘rt haftalik kurs qancha turadi? Erta band qilish qancha chegirma beradi?

scenes.title: Yakuniy matn javoblari
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: ming to‘qqiz yuz to‘qson sakkiz yilda; to‘rt yuz ellik o‘quvchi; olti yuz qirq funt; o‘n foiz. Raqamlarni tez ushlash uchun mashq kerak, ayniqsa “forty” va “fourteen” kabi o‘xshash so‘zlarda. Yana bir tuzoq: “thirty countries” bu o‘quvchilar soni emas, mamlakatlar soni; savolga mos raqamni tanlash scanning ning bir qismi.
scenes.say: Nineteen ninety-eight. Four hundred and fifty students. Six hundred and forty pounds. Ten per cent. Remember that thirty is the number of countries, not students, so check that the number fits the question.
scenes.say_uz: Ming to‘qqiz yuz to‘qson sakkiz. To‘rt yuz ellik o‘quvchi. Olti yuz qirq funt. O‘n foiz. O‘ttiz bu mamlakatlar soni, o‘quvchilar emas, shuning uchun raqam savolga mosligini tekshiring.

scenes.title: Gapirish: gistni ikki gapda ayting
board: Summarise the sleep text in 2 sentences
scenes.say_native: Endi gapirish mashqi. Uyqu haqidagi uch xatboshini eslang va ularning gistini ikki gapda ayting. Birinchi gapda mavzu, ikkinchisida asosiy xabar bo‘lsin. Tafsilotlarga, masalan kofe soatiga, kirmang. Boshlashingiz mumkin: “The text explains that…”
scenes.say: Summarise the sleep text in two sentences. First give the topic, then the main message. You can begin with: The text explains that.
scenes.say_uz: Uyqu haqidagi matnni ikki gapda xulosa qiling. Avval mavzu, keyin asosiy xabar. Boshlash mumkin: The text explains that.

scenes.title: Namunaviy xulosa
board: The text explains that good sleep depends on several factors.
It suggests there is no perfect pattern, but screens and caffeine can harm sleep.
scenes.say_native: Namuna: “The text explains that good sleep depends on several factors. It suggests there is no single perfect pattern, but screens and caffeine can harm our rest.” Ikki gap, tafsilotsiz, lekin mazmun to‘liq. Sizniki boshqacha bo‘lsa ham yaxshi, asosiysi: mavzu, keyin asosiy xabar.
scenes.say: A model answer: The text explains that good sleep depends on several factors. It suggests there is no single perfect pattern, but screens and caffeine can harm our rest.
scenes.say_uz: Namuna: Matn yaxshi uyqu bir necha omilga bog‘liqligini tushuntiradi. U yagona mukammal tartib yo‘qligini, lekin ekranlar va kofein dam olishga zarar qilishi mumkinligini aytadi.

scenes.title: Dars xulosasi
board: Skim: gist, 1 min, no unknown words
Scan: predict, sweep, stop, read around
Headings: main idea, each used once
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Skimming: sarlavha, birinchi va oxirgi xatboshi, har xatboshining birinchi gapi, signal so‘zlar. Scanning: javob shaklini taxmin qiling, sinonimlarga tayyor bo‘ling, mos joyni topib atrofini o‘qing. Sarlavhalarni moslashtirishda asosiy fikrni qidiring. Vaqtni oldindan rejalang, qiyin savolni belgilab o‘ting. Bu to‘rt qurol bilan o‘qish imtihoni sizga bo‘ysunadi.
scenes.say: Skim for the gist. Scan by predicting, sweeping, stopping and reading around. Match headings by the main idea. Plan your time and move on from hard questions.
scenes.say_uz: Gist uchun skimming qiling. Scanning da taxmin qiling, ko‘z yugurtiring, to‘xtang va atrofini o‘qing. Sarlavhani asosiy fikr bo‘yicha moslang. Vaqtni rejalang va qiyin savoldan o‘ting.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Homework: scan a text for 8 facts in 3 minutes
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: o‘zingiz tanlagan to‘rt yuz-besh yuz so‘zli ingliz tilidagi matnni, masalan yangilik maqolasi yoki varaqni oling. Avval matnni o‘qimay, sakkizta fakt savoli yozing: raqam, ism, sana, joy va boshqalar. Keyin taymerni uch daqiqaga qo‘yib, javoblarni qidiring. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: kamida yettita to‘g‘ri javob. Keyingi darsda ko‘chirma gapni to‘liq tizim sifatida o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework is to scan a text for eight facts in three minutes. Next time we will study reported speech as a full system.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz: uch daqiqada matndan sakkizta faktni topish. Keyingi darsda ko‘chirma gapni to‘liq tizim sifatida o‘rganamiz.

homework_uz: Ingliz tilida 400–500 so‘zli matn tanlang (yangilik maqolasi, varaq yoki ma’lumot sahifasi). Matnni o‘qimay turib, sakkizta fakt savolini yozing: raqam, ism, sana, narx, joy. Taymerni uch daqiqaga qo‘ying va javoblarni scanning bilan toping. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: kamida yettita to‘g‘ri javob, ishlatgan vaqtingiz esa uch daqiqadan oshmasin. Keyingi darsda ko‘chirma gapni o‘rganamiz.

quiz.q: What is the purpose of skimming?
quiz.why_uz: Skimming umumiy mazmunni, ya’ni gistni tushunish uchun.

quiz.q: Which part of a text should you read first when skimming?
quiz.why_uz: Skimming sarlavha va birinchi gaplardan boshlanadi.

quiz.q: You need a phone number in a leaflet. Which skill do you use?
quiz.why_uz: Aniq ma'lumot, masalan raqam, scanning bilan topiladi.

quiz.q: Question: How much do children pay? Text: Under-16s pay £7. What helps you?
options: Searching only for the word children
Knowing that child can be paraphrased
quiz.why_uz: Savoldagi so‘z matnda sinonim bilan almashishi mumkin.

quiz.q: The text never mentions a car park. The statement says: There is free parking. Answer?
quiz.why_uz: Matnda umuman aytilmagan bo‘lsa, javob Not Given.

quiz.q: You have 60 minutes for three texts. What is a sensible plan?
options: About 18 minutes per text and time to check
quiz.why_uz: Vaqtni teng taqsimlab, tekshirishga ham joy qoldiring.

quiz.q: A paragraph repeats the word money, but is really about saving time. A heading says Spending money. What should you do?
options: Look for the heading that matches the main idea
quiz.why_uz: Bir xil so‘z tuzoq bo‘lishi mumkin; asosiy fikrni tanlang.

options: changes direction or adds a contrast

quiz.q: You meet an unknown word that is not in any question. Best action?
quiz.why_uz: Savolda bo‘lmagan so‘zni o‘tkazib yuborish vaqtni tejaydi.
Paragraph so‘zida urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda: PAragraph.
